notes: Every constraint is clear once found. Each decoy fails exactly one constraint, which makes for a clean puzzle.

Cyrus never says 'peanut' himself in this chat. The allergy has to come from the 'satay incident' callback plus Brooke's list (no satay, no dipping sauce, nothing crushed on top). A player who has not played earlier levels can still work it out from Brooke's line and the peanut-heavy reviews, but it is the least direct clue. That seems fine for level 9.

The budget is implied ('one pricey lunch and i'm eating toast'), not given as a tier. The review that calls River Bell 'a step up from the usual intern lunch', together with its $$ card, makes the comparison clear enough.

Orchid Row's review mentions a 'crunchy green papaya salad'. Real-world som tam often comes with peanuts, which could make a cautious player hesitate, but the other review clearly says none of the dishes or sauces have peanuts. Not unfair, just a small trap.
Each venue card shows only name, cuisine and price, so the reviews do all the work for allergy and greasiness. That works well here.
